XLE stayed the rotate-out (Peaking) and XLV the Weakening level-leader. Real-asset leadership stayed the industrial/cyclical CPER leg (54.1 -> 54.3, Uptrend) with crypto holding (BTC-USD 39.6 flat Mixed; IBIT 32.1 flat Downtrend; GLD 21 -> 21.4 still Downtrend; SLV 0 dead). CRITICAL PERSISTENCE GATE: this is a recompute of the SAME distinct market-bar date (07-30), so the growth tilt's distinct-bar count is STILL 1 - intraday durability is NOT the same as multi-date persistence; a second distinct bar-date is required before the flip can be graded persistent.
experimental.method: On successive intraday windows of the SAME live session bar (open -> pre-close) following a freshly-opened leadership flip, test whether the flip is DURABLE-BUT-UNCONFIRMED by decomposing where the durability comes from: (1) REGIME/PRICE LEG STRENGTHENS = VIX still falling and below the 20 band boundary with regime score 0 AND the bench advances and narrows its distance to the 50-day across the intraday windows; (2) ROTATION LEG FAILS-TO-CONFIRM = the rotate-into ticker is unchanged (same category) but its near-term relative-momentum (rsMom1m) does NOT improve (here XLK rsMom1m -6.67 -> -7.1) while rsMom3m/6m merely hold positive; (3) REAL-ASSET/CRYPTO CONTEXT HOLDS = the real-asset leader stays a cyclical/industrial leg and crypto scores hold while gold/silver stay Downtrend. Emit a 'durable-but-unconfirmed intraday flip' pattern when (1) fires but (2) shows the rotation leg failing to confirm - i.e. the thaw is being carried by vol/price, not by a strengthening rotation. HARD PERSISTENCE GATE: count persistence by DISTINCT market-bar dates ONLY; multiple intraday recomputes of the 07-30 bar do NOT increment the counter, so the growth tilt stays at a distinct-bar count of 1 and cannot be graded 'persistent' until a second distinct date confirms it.
